title: Feasibility Ceilings Before Learning: Sizing and Timing Bounds for Drone-Mesh Interception
description:
arXiv:2610.20823v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: A mesh of interceptors defending a fixed site must spread over the predicted arrival point of an approaching object. This is a recurring task in multi-agent robotics: N agents, each covering a disc of radius r, spread over a probability density so that a point drawn from it falls within some agent's disc.
